title: Sales Development Representative
description: Sales Development Representative Rotoplastics Barbados Ltd St. Michael Not disclosed Not disclosed Updated 13/11/2026 Human Resource Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save Sales Development Representative Rotoplastics Barbados Ltd. is seeking an energetic and commercially focused Sales Development Representative to drive business growth, expand market presence, and strengthen relationships with key customers across Barbados. This is a highly visible, field-based role responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic customer relationships, increasing product penetration, and expanding distribution across multiple market segments. The successful candidate will play a critical role in growing sales across our diverse portfolio, including water storage solutions, pumps, water heaters, wastewater systems, waste management products, coolers, ropes, twines, and other industrial and consumer products. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Market Expansion Identify, prospect, and secure new business opportunities across Barbados. Expand Rotoplastics' customer base within key sectors including hardware, construction, plumbing, hospitality, commercial, industrial, property management, and government. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline with clear conversion targets. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and emerging opportunities. Participate in trade events, customer demonstrations, and business development initiatives to strengthen brand presence. Key Account Management Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic and high-value customer accounts. Develop account plans focused on increasing sales, customer retention, and product penetration. Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and purchasing personnel. Conduct regular customer visits and business reviews to identify growth opportunities. Ensure customer enquiries, quotations, and service requests are handled efficiently and professionally. Sales Growth & Product Penetration Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Drive growth across the full Rotoplastics product portfolio. Identify and execute cross-selling and upselling opportunities. Promote solutions tailored to customer needs while increasing share of wallet within existing accounts. Support promotional campaigns and customer-specific sales initiatives. Route-to-Market Development Increase product availability and visibility across key distribution channels. Identify underserved territories, customer segments, and market opportunities. Recommend new distribution partners, retail locations, and commercial partnerships. Conduct field audits to assess product presence, pricing, stock levels, and competitor activity. Customer Relationship Management Serve as a trusted advisor and primary commercial contact for assigned customers. Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain long-term business relationships. Resolve customer concerns promptly by coordinating with internal departments. Ensure commitments made to customers are accurately communicated and executed. Sales Planning & Reporting Maintain accurate customer, pipeline, and opportunity records. Prepare weekly activity reports, forecasts, and sales updates. Track customer performance, sales trends, account growth, and conversion rates. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to support strategic decision-making. Qualifications & Experience Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Management, or a related field. Minimum of 3-5 years' experience in business development, B2B sales, field sales, or key account management. Proven success in acquiring new customers and growing existing accounts. Experience within building materials, hardware, construction, plumbing, water systems, industrial products, distribution, or related sectors would be considered an asset. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Outlook. Experience using CRM or ERP systems is advantageous. Valid Barbados Driver's Licence and willingness to travel extensively throughout Barbados. Core Competencies Strong prospecting and business development skills Commercial awareness and strategic thinking Excellent negotiation and closing abilities Strong relationship-building and networking skills Effective planning and organizational capabilities High levels of initiative, accountability, and self-motivation Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities A results-driven approach with a passion for exceeding targets Ref: Sales Development Representative Apply Now
